title: Male roe deer growl
author: 1bumer
changes: A male European roe deer (Capreolus capreolus) giving one short alarm bark (the Polish description on the file page reads 'Szczekanie samca sarny', barking of a male roe deer). Trimmed to 1.05–2.35 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
